scope: Fixed retained geometries and thermal terms; functional/solvent sensitivity, not experimental accuracy, a complete aqueous ensemble or a production replacement.
geometry_rule: All3oxidized and4reduced core minima; one lowest-total-kJ retained minimum for each large cofactor, tie-broken by ordered geometry SHA. Original41/55fullcofactor ensembles remain unchanged.
thermal_terms: Original retained RRHO terms; no new Hessians or geometry optimization.
uncertainty: No new total-error intervals. DF numerical smoke is not a bound on large-molecule fitting error. No orbital-stability or completeness proof is claimed.
